**6. Momentum Stocks?**

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Mixed to weak: Tech: 6/19 positive (estimate). AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -0.50% | 1M: -6.11%), MSFT BELOW TREND (1W: -1.64% | 1M: -2.65%), GOOGL ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.88% | 1M: +7.53%) — selective winners but overall internal rotation.

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Pressure: Financials: 4/20 positive (estimate). JPM BELOW TREND (1W: -7.09% | 1M: -1.60%), V BELOW TREND (1W: -8.30% | 1M: -5.14%), AXP BELOW TREND (1W: -6.66% | 1M: -6.78%) — sector showing weakness and headline sensitivity.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Mixed/defensive tilt: Healthcare: 7/15 positive (estimate). JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.33% | 1M: +1.73%), LLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.24% | 1M: +6.72%), UNH BELOW TREND (1W: -4.31% | 1M: -0.83%) — some defensive accumulation but not uniform.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Maintain neutral posture and favor selective exposure to Consumer Staples and Industrials given breadth and leadership; reduce exposure to large-cap Financials and weak Tech names showing sustained BELOW TREND readings. Style: Mixed / no clear leadership — stay selective and monitor earnings/news flow.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +18.11% | 1M: +19.69%), GOOGL ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.88% | 1M: +7.53%), BA ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.40% | 1M: +21.84%).  
BEARISH: JPM BELOW TREND (1W: -7.09% | 1M: -1.60%), V BELOW TREND (1W: -8.30% | 1M: -5.14%), ADBE BELOW TREND (1W: -7.76% | 1M: -11.56%).

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Consumer Staples (Breadth supportive), Industrials (strong momentum).  
BEARISH: Technology (select names weak), Financials (headline-driven downside).

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
Watch NVDA for re-acceleration above its 1M trend to confirm any tech rebound (1W: -0.76% | 1M: +2.70% / TREND EXHAUSTION). Watch INTC continuation above near-term highs to confirm a durable shift (1W: +18.11% | 1M: +19.69% / ABOVE TREND). Watch JPM for failure below recent support after heavy 1W drop (1W: -7.09% | 1M: -1.60% / BELOW TREND). Watch PFE for price response to bullish deal headlines (1W: -1.10% | 1M: -2.52% / BELOW TREND).

PFE (+50): Pfizer Metsera deal headline; price diverging (1W: -1.10% | 1M: -2.52% | BELOW TREND) — sentiment outpacing price.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
MA (-60): Regulatory/headline risk; MA BELOW TREND (1W: -5.95% | 1M: -3.12%) — sentiment confirmed by price.  
AXP (-50): Policy risk headlines; AXP BELOW TREND (1W: -6.66% | 1M: -6.78%) — confirmed.  
QCOM (-50): Analyst downgrade; QCOM BELOW TREND (1W: -9.41% | 1M: -8.82%) — confirmed.  
ADBE (-50): Downgrade headline; ADBE BELOW TREND (1W: -7.76% | 1M: -11.56%) — confirmed.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with style mixed / no clear leadership. GOOGL ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.88% | 1M: +7.53%), INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +18.11% | 1M: +19.69%), BA ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.40% | 1M: +21.84%) showing relative strength. Key risk: concentrated tech/financial weakness and headline-driven sentiment (MA/AXP/QCOM) could keep momentum narrow and volatile.
